method: All contact surface triangles; per source triangulated face, centroid plus three strictly interior barycentric points (.6,.2,.2 permutations). Exact double precision closest-point distances to all marked target contact triangles. A sustained contact triangle requires all four samples <=.005mm and opposing closest normals at all four. Categories wall abs(n.axis)<.5, transition .5-.9, floor_rim >=.9. Unique triangulated face IDs, area counted once. Does not prove clearance outside marked interface; closest distance not solid intersection.
